issue: Logout through /backend/auth/logout.php redirected to a nonexistent relative index.php.
fix: Database-independent logout, cookie destruction and same-origin canonical login URL.
verification: Baseline Location header + supplied 404 screenshot; HTTP tests 20–21; actual Mezmur/logout browser clicks.

issue: Login shim relative redirects were wrong; alternate login parsed redirect/HTML as JSON.
fix: Preserve normal form redirects; explicit JSON contract for fetch; alternate form uses that contract; validate scalar credentials and rotate session/CSRF identity.
verification: Both direct/shim authentication exercised; alternate login → Mezmur browser test; existing form-login checks pass.

issue: Idle-timeout directory traversal could remain at / forever on frontend/backend paths.
fix: Replace traversal with deterministic URL helper; destroy expired sessions and create fresh anonymous sessions on public/login pages.
verification: Controlled stale session: frontend request redirects within three seconds; login page publishes a fresh token.

issue: Privileged-session revalidation did not cover migrated frontend/backend routes.
fix: Include these areas in existing periodic account/password/role checks and recognize JSON shim requests.
verification: Disabled synthetic Finance account rejected at the backend shim after forced revalidation. Interval remains 300 seconds.

issue: Login and several legacy account controllers started sessions before security bootstrap.
fix: One database-independent secure session bootstrap, reused before identity reads; HttpOnly, Lax and strict-mode behavior retained on PHP 8.2/8.4.
verification: Cookie headers, source/CGI checks, and both PHP HTTP suites.

issue: PHP addslashes was not a safe script bridge; several HTML escapers left attribute quotes unescaped.
fix: JSON_HEX encoding for APP bootstrap; attribute-safe escaping; JSON-encoded attendance-card handler argument.
verification: Synthetic </script> name survives as data; focused browser attribute-injection probe; broad role rendering. Legacy templates have changed-section, not complete manual, coverage.

issue: HTTP-accessible test seeding/tooling could load live configuration and mutate data without a department login.
fix: Block tests/tools/repository metadata/dependency paths; CLI checks before config in PHP test scripts; explicit opt-in for destructive E2E seeding.
verification: Apache path-denial tests and independent CGI execution prove PHP guards work without .htaccess. No unsafe seeder request was sent to production.

issue: Root rewrite denials were not automatically inherited where admin/.htaccess declared its own rewrite rules.
fix: Repeat targeted deployment/debug/library denials inside admin; preserve active backup, health and year-rollover tools.
verification: Actual Apache probes; backup create/download/decrypt regression protects against blanket-directory blocking.

issue: Executable-file denials missed cPanel .php8 and multi-extension names.
fix: Final case-insensitive denial covers PHP variants, PHAR and executable suffixes, including file.php.jpg.
verification: Harmless temporary .php8, .php.jpg and .phar files return 403; normal private PDF streaming still works.

issue: Transaction date was bound as integer.
fix: Correct binding metadata so a Gregorian DATE survives insertion.
verification: HTTP transaction insert and database assertion of exact 2026-08-22 date and 123.45 amount.

issue: Paid fee and matching income were separate writes, used today instead of paid date, and assumed category ID 1.
fix: One transaction for both records; exact paid date and correct bindings; category lookup by intended income category rather than hardcoded ID.
verification: Injected second-write failure rolls the fee back; historical payment posts matching dated income. Existing damaged records are not auto-repaired.

issue: Weak input validation accepted invalid values/references or surfaced driver failures.
fix: Shared typed public validation errors; finite two-decimal money, whole quantities, valid dates/enums/lengths; reference checks and useful 4xx responses.
verification: Invalid values, wrong category type, missing members/IDs, date checks and no-database validator tests.

issue: Rapid save clicks could send duplicate writes; UTC-derived defaults could select the previous local day; paid-fee totals stayed stale.
fix: In-flight guards and disabled save buttons; local date defaults; refresh income and overview after paid fees.
verification: Browser double-call sends one INSERT and preserves exact date. This is NOT server-side retry idempotency.

issue: Item unit string was bound as integer; quantity binding metadata was also wrong.
fix: Correct insert/update bind types.
verification: Create/edit roundtrip retains piece/box, quantity, thresholds, price and date.

issue: Outgoing/disposal could overdraw and still log the requested amount; log/balance writes were not atomic; adjustment never changed quantity.
fix: Lock the item, enforce available stock and commit movement/balance/status together. Adjustment means counted absolute balance, including zero.
verification: Concurrent withdrawals yield one success and one 409; injected failure preserves stock; adjustment/status tests.

issue: Missing records could be reported as updated/deleted; item deletion orphaned movement/request history.
fix: Return not-found outcomes and refuse deletion of inventory with history; validate request quantities/statuses and links.
verification: CRUD roundtrips, nonexistent-reference checks and history-preserving delete rejection.

issue: Position edit bound seven values using six type characters; legacy_flag was bound numerically on create/edit.
fix: Correct arity and preserve the textual legacy flag.
verification: Real create/edit with is_staff → is_volunteer; database values and updated title verified.

issue: Notification/task IDs could be modified outside recipient scope; member-change old/new values were exposed as generic alerts.
fix: Match recipient predicates for writes; restrict detailed member-change history to member-management staff.
verification: Teacher cannot dismiss Finance notification/complete Finance task; intended recipient can; unrelated roles denied change feed.

issue: CSRF was checked only on POST, while several mutations could be reached using GET (including year-context clear and mark-all-read).
fix: Explicit POST requirement for enumerated Finance, Materials, notification, year-context, Education, subject, teacher and attendance-status writes.
verification: Wrong-method matrix checks 405 + Allow: POST; missing/array CSRF rejected without fatal errors.

issue: mysqli::in_transaction() does not exist; transfer path could fatally fail. First-enrollment concurrency was unprotected.
fix: Explicit transaction ownership/savepoints, member row locks, source-year validation, generic failure messages and reliable reused target IDs.
verification: Transfer there/back, concurrent first enrollment, outer-transaction rollback and injected failure tests. Callers owning a mysqli transaction must pass withinTransaction=true.

issue: Assumed department role could not pass restore endpoint gate; legacy restore button omitted CSRF.
fix: Only impersonation endpoint may use validated original privileged role; include CSRF in restore button.
verification: Switch/restore across nine supported roles; actual restore buttons on HR and migrated Mezmur pages.

issue: Head-loaded observer used document.body before it existed; duplicate inclusion redeclared calendar state; property-set values stayed visually stale; dynamic Gregorian inputs were converted.
fix: DOM-ready boot, single inclusion/initialization, value synchronization and mode-respecting refresh.
verification: All role page errors eliminated for calendar; dedicated head/duplicate/value/disabled/Gregorian browser contracts.

issue: No-assignment Teacher page tried to populate a submission element that was not rendered.
fix: Skip list request/render when the empty-state page has no list element.
verification: No-assignment teacher navigation has no null-element exception.

issue: Content-editor landing had no logout control and its header overflowed at phone width.
fix: Provide logout instead of a self-referential dashboard link; compact small-screen header.
verification: Content tabs/logout browser checks; no document overflow at 390px in final sweep.

issue: Unsafe referer redirect, self-lockout via Save, silent update of missing user, missing destructive CSRF and incomplete target-role toggle list.
fix: Same-origin allowlisted redirects; fresh bootstrap; field bounds; self-role/status protection; missing-user check; delete CSRF; new existing role types supported by toggle.
verification: Self-disable/demotion rejected; authenticated delete and canonical redirect checked. Full account-lifecycle atomicity remains open.

issue: Clearing the only notification recipient could turn a private message into a global broadcast.
fix: Remove single-recipient messages on account deletion; preserve already role-addressed messages.
verification: Delete synthetic recipient: private message disappears and shared message retains Finance role scope.

issue: Array inputs could fail validation; Amharic name length used bytes; fields were weakly bounded; file-based rate counter raced.
fix: Schema-aligned scalar/Unicode/phone/date-age bounds and shared atomic limiter (five accepted submissions/hour/IP).
verification: Malformed fields rejected; honeypot stores nothing; eight concurrent valid submissions produce exactly five successes and three 429s.

issue: Age used constant Gregorian-minus-eight and ignored actual birthday.
fix: Gregorian birthday-aware age with real Ethiopian year boundary/fallback for legacy Ethiopian fields.
verification: Fixed-date tests before/after birthday and Ethiopian new year; future date returns unknown. Year-only legacy input remains an estimate.

issue: Array-shaped routes reached trim() before the error handler; duplicate API marker definitions emitted warnings before config.
fix: Reject malformed routes with JSON 400 and define the API request marker only once.
verification: Malformed-route and REST role tests; independent PHP 8.2/8.4 CGI bootstrap tests with initial display_errors=1 return clean JSON.

issue: Leading UTF-8 BOM could precede headers.
fix: Remove BOM without changing report content.
verification: PHP lint/static check; broad role and report smoke coverage, not every legacy report template.

issue: Native confirm calls bypassed established in-app dialog; absent dialog could auto-accept a destructive action.
fix: Use existing system confirm and fail closed when dialog is unavailable; capture hymn identity for delayed confirmation.
verification: Existing no-browser-popup checks now pass; Mezmur E2E/filter/browser checks. Physical audio timing still needs staging.

issue: New Flutter test file did not compile; old DOM harness and CSRF assumptions caused false failures.
fix: Dart-3.3-compatible literals/non-const runtime strings; complete DOM stand-in; authenticated CSRF extraction; focused scope-aware assertions.
verification: Flutter 332 tests pass; existing E2E 154 pass; 31 other legacy assertions and six setup errors remain explicitly unresolved.
